Chord definition (ULSBS).description: Insert \[ ... ] (ULSBS). Place chord names and melody blocks within this.

Chord definition with melody block (ULSB.description: Insert a chord definition with a melody block: primary[;secondary][ @ offset].

Zero-advance chord definition with melod.description: Insert melody layers with zero advance; a following chord keeps its natural width.

Unmemorized chord definition with melody.description: Insert a melody block excluded from chord memorization.

Secondary melody position (ULSBS).description: Set the secondary melody position in the current TeX scope; same overlays the primary lane.

Primary melody position (ULSBS).description: Set the primary melody position in the current TeX scope; normal is the default.

Melody style mapping (ULSBS).description: Set the primary/secondary visual style mapping in the current TeX scope.

begin{ulSongs} ... end{ulSongs} (ULSBS).description: Insert ulSongs with its required index list (empty to collect no indices). Songs must be within ulSongs environments.

Tag-definition file (ULSBS).description: Preamble-only tag filename setter. An explicit missing file fails without default fallback.

Title index declaration (ULSBS).description: Declare a title index with a custom identifier and filename stem in the preamble.

Author index declaration (ULSBS).description: Declare a generated author index with a custom identifier and filename stem in the preamble.

Tag index declaration (ULSBS).description: Declare a tag index with a custom identifier and filename stem in the preamble.

begin{passage} ... end{passage} (ULSBS).description: Insert passage with an optional language code and a required title argument (which may be empty).
